sections.heading: C2 — KG hints for Vehicle Readiness: Maintenance, Seats, Mirrors
sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG hints for Vehicle Readiness: Maintenance, Seats, Mirrors

FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A01
Upkeep follows the owner manual schedule, while brake counts follow vehicle kind: twin systems for cars and ATVs, one for bikes [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint upkeep-brakes; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec08-F01 and sec08-F02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A01
Noise, odor, and sinking pedals are the brake warnings, while a mechanic visit is the only response [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint upkeep-brakes; prereq_hint sec08-F02; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec08-F03.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A02
Light checks happen outside the car, while the equipment counts demand two headlights, one red rear lamp, and a plate lamp [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint lights; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec08-F04 and sec08-F05.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A02
Any fitted signal must work, while signals become mandatory past 40 inches of width [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint lights; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec08-F06.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A02
Crooked beams need a mechanic re-aim, while dimmed lenses need only a wash [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint lights; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec08-F07 and sec08-F08.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A02
Broken glass gets replaced, while sound glass gets cleaned and washed with antifreeze fluid [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint glass-view; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec08-F09.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A02
Wipers and snow clearing are driver chores, while the 70-percent tint limit is the law with no medical pass [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint glass-view; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec08-F10 and sec08-F11.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-R08 | anchor: A02
Pressure gets gauged cold against the door sticker, while tread gets probed with a head-first penny [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint tires; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec08-F14 and sec08-F15.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-R09 | anchor: A02
Bald tires stretch stops and invite slides, while bouncing and pulling send the car to a mechanic [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint tires; prereq_hint sec08-F13; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec08-F13.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-R10 | anchor: A03
Stiff or lazy steering points at the steering gear, while endless bouncing points at shocks [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint chassis; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec08-F16 and sec08-F17.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-R11 | anchor: A03
A leaky exhaust can kill in minutes, which is why idling in a garage is never allowed [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint exhaust; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec08-F18.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-R12 | anchor: A03
A sour engine gets serviced by the manual, while the horn gets used for warnings only [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint engine-horn; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec08-F19 and sec08-F20.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-R13 | anchor: A03
The rearview must show 200 feet back, while vans must wear both outside mirrors regardless [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint mirrors; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec08-F21.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-R14 | anchor: A03
The seat holds ten inches of chest clearance, while the mirrors get set by the lean-and-glimpse method [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint seating; prereq_hint sec08-F22; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec08-F23 and sec08-F27.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]
